title: The Fox's Bowl
subject: maths
objective: Counts a set of up to 10 objects one at a time and states how many by tapping the matching numeral.
description: A fox waits beside an empty bowl while 2-10 berries lie on the mat; the child taps each berry once (its cell fills and takes the running number) then taps the numeral that says how many, and the berries tip into the bowl.

title: Number Nest
subject: maths
objective: Matches a spoken-free quantity cue (a dot set) to the correct numeral among three.
description: A nest shows 1-10 eggs; three numeral tiles fly in; tap the one that matches; wrong taps recount the eggs with highlights.

title: Ten-Frame Fill
subject: maths
objective: Builds a target quantity 1-10 on a ten-frame by toggling cells top row left to right.
description: A numeral shows; the child fills cells until the frame shows it; on Check missing/extra cells are enacted.

title: Bridge of Ten
subject: maths
objective: Chooses and places two stone-bags whose numbers together make exactly 10.
description: A river needs exactly 10 stones; a tray offers bags of 2, 3, 5, 7, 8; tap two bags onto the bridge; it holds only when the pair totals 10; wrong pairs show the gap or the overhang.

title: Shape Sorter
subject: maths
objective: Sorts rotated and resized 2D shapes into the correct named bin by attribute, not by orientation.
description: Shapes drift in one at a time in random orientations; tap the shape then its bin (icon-labelled); a rotated square counts as a square.

title: Letter Lantern
subject: literacy
objective: Identifies a named target letter among three visually similar letters.
description: A lantern shows the target letter big; three tiles offer it plus two confusables; tap the match; reversals get the "which side is the belly" cue.

title: Case Pairs
subject: literacy
objective: Pairs each uppercase letter with its lowercase form on a visible board.
description: Six letter tiles (3 upper, 3 lower) all face up; tap two that are the same letter; wrong pairs nudge apart; feedback morphs one form into the other.

title: Frog Hops
subject: maths
objective: Solves a + b (sums to 20) by starting at a and hopping b times along a number line.
description: A frog sits on the first addend (covered, numeral only); the child traces the hops through b lily pads; the landing pad is the answer.

title: Balance Pans
subject: maths
objective: Makes a two-pan scale balance by setting the missing value with +/− steppers so both sides are equal.
description: 3 + 4 sits on the left pan; the right pan shows _ + 5; step the blank until the beam is level; the beam tips visibly for wrong totals.

title: Array Reveal
subject: maths
objective: Predicts the product of a × b, then verifies it by revealing and counting the rows of an array.
description: A shutter hides an array labelled a rows of b; the child taps a product tile; the shutter slides open row by row with running totals.

title: Subitise Flash
subject: maths
objective: States how many dots were shown after a 1-second flash without counting.
description: A dice-style dot set flashes and hides; tap the numeral; the reveal shows the set again with the numeral.

title: Count Out That Many
subject: maths
topic: counting out N from a larger set
objective: Moves exactly N objects from a pile into a basket and stops.
description: A numeral shows on a basket; tap acorns from a pile of more into the basket; the basket closes only at N; overfill nudges the last acorn back.

title: More or Fewer Lines
subject: maths
topic: comparing two sets by one-to-one matching
objective: Compares two rows of objects by pairing them and identifies which row has more or fewer.
description: Two rows (one spread out); tap an object in each row to draw a pairing line; leftover objects show which row has more; then tap the "more" row.

title: Number Line Hop
subject: maths
objective: Taps numerals 1-20 in ascending order along a scattered path.
description: Numerals lie scattered on a pond; tap them in order to build the frog's path; a wrong tap nudges and the next correct numeral glows on the 2nd error.

title: Before and After
subject: maths
objective: Places the numerals that come just before and just after a shown number onto a strip.
description: A number sits mid-strip with an empty slot each side; tap the right numerals from a tray of four; wrong placements show the count on a number strip.

title: Tens Then Ones
subject: maths
topic: counting full tens plus loose ones to 100
objective: Counts a set of full ten-boxes then loose ones by tapping tens first (10, 20, 30) then ones (31, 32).
description: Boxes of ten eggs plus loose eggs; tap boxes, then singles; the running count switches from tens to ones; then tap the total.

title: Teen Pairs
subject: maths
topic: teen numbers as ten and some ones
objective: Pairs teen numerals (11-19) with pictures showing one ten-rod and the matching ones.
description: Visible board: numerals and rod-and-cubes pictures; tap two that match; 16 vs 61 confusions get the tens-then-ones highlight.

title: Tens and Ones Shop
subject: maths
topic: two-digit numbers as rods and cubes
objective: Represents a two-digit number by placing the right number of ten-rods and one-cubes.
description: A price tag 10-99 shows; tap rods and cubes into the tray; rods cannot be split; the tray total shows only on Check.

title: Read the Rods
subject: maths
topic: reading a two-digit number from base-ten blocks
objective: Types the two-digit number shown by rods and cubes.
description: Rods and cubes (in mixed arrangement) show; keypad entry; wrong answers re-arrange the blocks into tens-then-ones with counts.

title: Hundred-Square Trail
subject: maths
objective: Finds the cell that is 1 or 10 more/less than a given cell on a hundred square.
description: A cell is lit; an arrow icon says +10 / −1 etc.; tap the target cell; wrong cells show the row/column move enacted.

title: Make Five Friends
subject: maths
objective: Pairs numerals and dot-sets that together make 5 on a visible board.
description: Tiles 0-5 as dots and numerals; tap two that total 5; a five-frame shows the pair filling it.

title: Bond Bracelets
subject: maths
objective: Splits a whole of 6-10 beads into two parts in three different ways for the same whole.
description: A bracelet of N beads; tap a bead to set the split point; each new split must differ from the ones already recorded on the tally.

title: Hidden Part Cup
subject: maths
topic: missing part of a bond to 10
objective: States how many counters are hidden under a cup given the whole and the visible part.
description: 8 counters total; some go under a cup; tap the numeral for the hidden part; the cup lifts and counts them out.

title: Domino Add
subject: maths
topic: addition within 10 from two subitised parts
objective: Adds the two halves of a domino without counting all and taps the total.
description: A domino shows 4 and 3 as dot patterns; three numeral tiles; wrong taps count on from the larger half with highlights.

title: Doubles Mirror
subject: maths
objective: Predicts the double of a number then verifies it in a mirrored dot set.
description: Dots on the left of a mirror; tap the product tile; the mirror reveals the reflection and the total counts up.

title: Near-Doubles Ladder
subject: maths
objective: Solves n + (n+1) by choosing the double-plus-one strategy card and its answer.
description: 6 + 7 shows; first tap "6 + 6 + 1" among three strategy cards; then the answer; feedback shows the extra dot.

title: Ten Helper
subject: maths
topic: make-ten strategy: split the second addend
objective: Chooses the split of the second addend that fills the first number to ten (8 + 5 = 8 + 2 + 3).
description: 8 + 5 shows with a ten-frame holding 8; three split cards (2+3, 1+4, 4+1); tap the one whose first part fills the frame; the frame fills and 10 + 3 appears.

title: Take-Away Tray
subject: maths
objective: Removes b objects from a and counts what remains.
description: A tray of a biscuits; tap b of them (they get eaten one by one with a count); tap the remaining count.

title: How Many More
subject: maths
objective: Finds the difference between two rows by pairing and counting the unmatched objects.
description: Two rows of animals; pair them with tap-tap lines; the unpaired ones are counted; tap the difference numeral.

title: Count-Back Cliff
subject: maths
objective: Solves a − b by tracing b hops backwards from a on a number line, not counting the start.
description: A goat on a; trace b hops left; the start pad does not count; wrong landings show the off-by-one hop highlighted.

title: Missing-Number Bridge
subject: maths
objective: Sets the missing addend with steppers until the bridge planks span the gap exactly.
description: Planks of a laid; a gap to c; step the blank; too few leaves a hole, too many overhang.

title: True or Not
subject: maths
objective: Decides whether a shown equation is true and shows why on a balance.
description: An equation in non-standard form; tap the balanced or tipped scale tile; the scale then enacts both sides.

title: Fact-Family House
subject: maths
objective: Builds the four related facts of a family by placing numerals into equation frames.
description: A roof holds 3, 4, 7; four empty frames; tap numerals into slots; each frame locks when true.

title: Next Ten Gap
subject: maths
topic: complement to the next ten for a two-digit number
objective: Predicts how many more make the next ten from a two-digit number, then sees the gap fill.
description: 47 on a number line; tap 3 among three tiles; three counters hop to 50 and the line marks the ten.

title: Hundred-Square Add
subject: maths
topic: two-digit addition by tens-then-ones moves on a hundred square
objective: Adds 47 + 25 by tracing two moves down (tens) then five moves right (ones) on a hundred square.
description: Start cell lit; trace the path through waypoints; a wrong row-change shows the +10 move enacted; the landing cell is the sum.

title: Count Back Across Ten
subject: maths
topic: two-digit subtraction on a number line crossing a ten
objective: Subtracts 42 − 17 by hopping back 10, then to 30, then the rest on a number line.
description: Trace hops 42→32→30→25; the ten-mark is a waypoint; a smaller-from-larger attempt has no waypoint to land on.

title: Round Up or Down
subject: maths
objective: Sorts two-digit numbers into rounds-down and rounds-up bins and names the ten.
description: Numbers stream; bins labelled with a down-hill and up-hill icon; a mini number line shows the nearer ten on error; 5s follow the rule shown on the bin.

title: Three-Digit Builder
subject: maths
objective: Builds a three-digit number from flats, rods and cubes including a zero place.
description: 305 shows; fill the three columns; an empty tens column must stay empty; readout only on Check.

title: Skip-Count Socks
subject: maths
objective: Counts pairs of socks in twos by tapping each pair once.
description: Socks pegged in pairs; each tap says 2, 4, 6…; tap the total; miscounts replay by pairs.

title: Fives Hands
subject: maths
objective: Counts groups of five by tapping each hand and reading the running total.
description: Hands held up; tap each to add 5; then tap the total numeral among three. `[deliberate: the same tap-each-group mechanic as 039 on the unit five — skip-count units are practised one per game; L3 adds partial hands so totals leave the multiples]`

title: Skip Trail
subject: maths
topic: skip counting 2s/5s/10s on a hundred square from any start
objective: Continues a skip-count trail on a hundred square from a given start, including off-multiple starts.
description: Three cells lit (e.g. 3, 5, 7); tap the next four; wrong cells show the jump size enacted.

title: Odd or Even Pairs
subject: maths
objective: Decides whether a set is even or odd by pairing its objects and sorting the set into the even or odd bin.
description: Objects pair up on tap; one left over means odd; tap the bin; the leftover object pulses as the cue.

title: Pattern Train
subject: maths
objective: Extends a repeating pattern by placing the next two items.
description: A train of shapes/animals in a pattern; two empty wagons; tap the right items from a tray; the unit brackets on error.

title: Find the Unit
subject: maths
objective: Identifies the smallest repeating unit of a pattern by tapping its items in order.
description: A long pattern; tap the items that make one unit; brackets appear; a copied last element is refused.

title: Growing Steps
subject: maths
objective: Builds the next term of a growing pattern on a grid.
description: Staircases of 1, 3, 5 blocks; build the fourth on the grid; wrong builds show the +2 difference.

title: Number Pattern Gaps
subject: maths
objective: Fills a gap in a numeric sequence (steps of 2, 3, 5, 10) by typing the missing term.
description: 4, 7, 10, _, 16; keypad; wrong answers draw the equal jumps on a line.

title: Groups Picture
subject: maths
objective: Picks the picture that shows N groups of M (not M groups of N).
description: Prompt as icons: 3 plates × 4; three pictures (3 of 4, 4 of 3, 3 of 3); tap; the plates and their contents are labelled by icon on error.

title: Array Turn
subject: maths
objective: Predicts whether 3 rows of 4 and 4 rows of 3 have the same total, then watches the array rotate.
description: An array shows; tap same/different; the array turns 90° and both counts appear.

title: Times-Table Tiles
subject: maths
objective: Retrieves products in the 2, 5 and 10 tables from a choice of three.
description: A fact card; three product tiles; wrong taps reveal the array; missed facts re-queue with expanding lag.

title: Times-Table Keypad
subject: maths
objective: Types products for the 3, 4, 6 and 8 tables.
description: Fact shown; keypad; wrong answers show the array building; the session interleaves tables after an introduction block.

title: Fair Share
subject: maths
objective: Predicts how many each of K plates gets when N objects are shared equally, then watches the deal.
description: 12 cherries, 3 plates; tap the per-plate tile; the deal enacts one by one; unequal predictions show the leftover.

title: Share or Group
subject: maths
objective: Sorts picture problems into share-among-N and make-groups-of-N bins.
description: Picture cards stream (12 among 4 plates / 12 in bags of 4); bins with plate and bag icons; the deal enacts on error.

title: Leftovers
subject: maths
objective: Predicts how many are left over when N is shared among K, then verifies by sharing.
description: 14 among 4: tap the remainder tile; the deal enacts and the leftovers glow.

title: Fair or Not
subject: maths
objective: Chooses which of three cuts divides a shape into two equal halves.
description: Three pancakes each cut differently; tap the fair one; the halves overlay to compare on error.

title: Quarter Quilt
subject: maths
objective: Shades exactly one quarter (or three quarters) of a shape divided into equal parts.
description: A quilt square in 4 patches; shade N; feedback overlays patches to show equal size.

title: Fraction Bars
subject: maths
topic: comparing unit fractions of the same whole
objective: Chooses the larger of two unit fractions by comparing bars of the same whole.
description: 1/4 vs 1/8 as bars; tap the bigger; the bars overlay; "bigger denominator = bigger" is enacted as smaller pieces.

title: Fraction Number Line
subject: maths
objective: Places a fraction (halves, quarters, thirds) on a 0-1 number line.
description: Tap the tick for 3/4; the line subdivides on error to show the parts.

title: Shape Detective 3D
subject: maths
topic: 3D shapes named (cube, sphere, cone, cylinder, cuboid)
objective: Names a 3D shape shown as an outline with shading among three names/icons.
description: A solid rotates through three views; tap its name tile; "ball is a circle" gets the shadow-vs-object reveal.

title: Side Counter
subject: maths
objective: Counts the sides of a polygon by tapping each side once.
description: A polygon in random orientation; tap each side (it lights); tap the count; double-taps do nothing.

title: Symmetry Mirror
subject: maths
objective: Completes the mirror half of a figure on a grid across a vertical line.
description: Half a butterfly on a peg grid; fill the mirrored cells; wrong cells reflect back across the line as feedback.

title: Sound Hunt
subject: literacy
objective: Taps every picture in a scene whose name starts with the target sound and states how many there were.
description: A letter tile shows the target; a scene of eight pictures; tap each one that starts with it (it glows and counts); non-targets nudge; then tap the count tile.

title: Rhyme Bus
subject: literacy
objective: Identifies which of three pictured words does not rhyme with the others [locale].
description: Three passengers say their names via picture; tap the one that doesn't rhyme; distractors include a same-onset word.

title: Syllable Drums
subject: literacy
objective: Taps a drum once per syllable of a pictured word and states the count [locale].
description: A picture; tap the drum per beat (tokens appear); tap the number; fast-speech elision is caught by the slow model replay.

title: Letter Path
subject: literacy
objective: Traces an uppercase print letter through its stroke waypoints in order.
description: Big letter with numbered waypoints; trace; the letter sets; reversals cannot happen because the path is fixed.

title: Lowercase Path
subject: literacy
objective: Traces a lowercase print letter through its stroke waypoints.
description: Same mechanic, lowercase forms; b/d get a belly-side cue before tracing. `[deliberate: formation needs both cases; separate letter sets]`

title: Alphabet Arc
subject: literacy
objective: Places 4 letters into alphabetical order by tapping them in sequence.
description: Scattered letters; tap in order onto an arc; the full alphabet strip is a hint on error.

title: Letter-Sound Sort
subject: literacy
objective: Sorts pictures into two bins by their initial sound [locale].
description: Bins labelled by a letter tile; pictures stream; tap picture then bin; wrong bins pulse the letter.

title: End-Sound Catch
subject: literacy
objective: Picks the picture whose name ends with the target sound [locale].
description: Same as Sound Start with final sounds; nasal/liquid endings get the extra sound box.

title: Sound Slide
subject: literacy
objective: Blends three sound tiles into a word by sliding them together and picks the matching picture [locale].
description: Three tiles apart; tap each in order and they slide together with a gliding tone; tap the picture it makes.

title: Sound Boxes
subject: literacy
objective: Places letter tiles into sound boxes for a pictured word [locale].
description: A picture and 3-4 boxes; tap letters into boxes; a digraph is one tile; a missing middle box refuses to close.

title: Vowel Swap
subject: literacy
objective: Chooses the word that matches a picture from a minimal pair differing in the vowel [locale].
description: Picture of a pin; tiles PEN / PIN; tap; the vowel highlights on error.

title: Word Wheel
subject: literacy
objective: Turns a wheel of onsets against a fixed rime to make real words and stops on the pictured one [locale].
description: A rime "-at"; step the onset wheel; tap Check when the word matches the picture.

title: Syllable Snap
subject: literacy
objective: Pairs two syllable tiles that make a pictured word [locale; Romance-first].
description: Six syllable tiles; tap two that make one of the three pictured words; wrong pairs nudge apart.

title: Word Picture Pairs
subject: literacy
objective: Pairs written words with their pictures on a visible board where decoys share the first letter.
description: Six tiles: three words (cat, can, cap) and three pictures; tap two; first-letter guessing pairs the wrong picture and nudges.

title: Sentence Train
subject: literacy
objective: Orders 3-5 word cards into a sentence that matches a picture [locale sentence sets].
description: Cards scattered; tap in order onto the train; the capital and full stop are cues.

title: Capital and Stop
subject: literacy
objective: Fixes a sentence by placing a capital at the start and a stop at the end.
description: A sentence with a lowercase start and no stop; tap the capital tile onto the first word and the stop tile onto the end.

title: Question or Telling
subject: literacy
objective: Sorts sentences into "asks" or "tells" bins and adds the right end mark.
description: Sentences stream; tap sentence then bin; the bin stamps ? or .

title: Story Order
subject: literacy
objective: Orders picture panels of a short story first to last.
description: Three panels; tap in order; feedback shows cause→effect arrows.

title: What Happened Next
subject: literacy
objective: Chooses the panel that fits between two shown story panels.
description: Panels 1 and 3 shown; three candidates for 2; tap; wrong choices show the clue in panel 1.

title: Who Said It
subject: literacy
topic: comprehension: literal recall from a short text
objective: Reads a 2-sentence text and answers a who/what/where question by tapping a picture [locale].
description: Text plus three picture answers; the answer sentence highlights on error.

title: Clue Inference
subject: literacy
objective: Infers an unstated fact from two visible clues in a short text [locale].
description: A 3-sentence text; a question whose answer combines two sentences; those two highlight on error.

title: Category Baskets
subject: literacy
objective: Sorts pictured objects into two category baskets (animals/food, clothes/toys).
description: Pictures stream; tap then basket; the basket icon shows the category.

title: Opposites Bridge
subject: literacy
objective: Pairs pictures showing opposite attributes.
description: Visible board of six pictures; tap two opposites; wrong pairs nudge.

title: Size Words
subject: literacy
objective: Orders three pictured objects by a named attribute word.
description: "Tallest to shortest": tap in order; the rail shows the size bars.

title: Spell by Sound
subject: literacy
objective: Types a pictured regular word letter by letter from its sounds [locale].
description: Picture; letter bank keypad; wrong letters show the sound boxes filling.

title: Double-Letter Drop
subject: literacy
objective: Completes a word by placing the correct spelling-pattern tile into a gap [locale patterns].
description: ru_ing with tiles n / nn; tap the tile into the gap; the pattern rule shows on error.

title: Plural Parade
subject: literacy
objective: Sorts pictured nouns into "one" and "many" bins with the matching word form [locale].
description: One dog / three dogs pictures with word tiles; tap into bins.

title: Noun or Verb
subject: literacy
objective: Sorts words into "a thing" and "an action" bins [locale].
description: Word tiles stream; bins with a box icon and a running-figure icon; wrong bins show the word in a sentence.

title: Describing Words
subject: literacy
objective: Picks the adjective that matches a picture from three [locale].
description: A picture of a wet, red or big object; three word tiles; feedback highlights the attribute.

title: End Marks
subject: literacy
objective: Chooses the end mark that fits a sentence [locale].
description: A sentence with a blank end; tiles . ? !; exclamation used playfully is accepted.

title: Living or Not
subject: science
objective: Sorts things into living and non-living by whether they eat, grow and move on their own.
description: Pictures stream (a cloud moves but is not alive); tap into bins labelled with growth/food icons.

title: Plant Needs
subject: science
objective: Gives a wilting plant exactly the three things it needs (sun, water, air) from a tray of six.
description: Tap items onto the plant; wrong items (a sweet, a hat) glide back; the plant perks up at three correct.

title: Seed to Flower
subject: science
objective: Orders the stages of a plant's life from seed to flower to seed.
description: Five stage tiles; tap in order onto a growth wheel; arrows show cause→effect on error.

title: Animal Features
subject: science
objective: Sorts animals into bins by feature (feathers, fur, fins, six legs).
description: Animal emoji stream; bins with feature icons; whale/penguin appear at level 3.

title: Who Lives Where
subject: science
objective: Pairs animals with their habitat pictures.
description: Visible board; tap animal then habitat; wrong pairs show the habitat's feature icon.

title: Life-Cycle Wheel
subject: science
objective: Orders the stages of an animal life cycle on a wheel.
description: Egg, tadpole, froglet, frog; tap in order; wrong order shows the growth arrow.

title: Body Parts
subject: science
objective: Places named body-part labels (as icons) onto the right place of a figure.
description: Tap an icon (eye, hand, knee) then the body location; wrong spots nudge back.

title: Five Senses
subject: science
objective: Sorts everyday objects into the sense you mainly use for them (see, hear, smell, taste, touch).
description: Objects stream; five bins with organ icons; a bell goes to hearing.

title: Season Dresser
subject: science
objective: Dresses a character for a shown season with the matching clothes and objects.
description: A season scene (tree state + temperature icon); tap clothes onto the character; hemisphere-neutral cues (no snow-only winter).

title: Weather Match
subject: science
objective: Matches a weather picture to what you would see or need (umbrella, sunglasses).
description: Weather tile; three object tiles; tap the match.

title: Day and Night
subject: science
objective: Orders daily events from morning to night by the sun's position.
description: Four event tiles with sky cues; tap in order; no astronomy causation.

title: Material Sort
subject: science
objective: Sorts the same object made of different materials by a named property.
description: A wooden, metal and plastic spoon; bins "bends" / "does not bend"; property tested on tap.

title: Float or Sink
subject: science
objective: Predicts whether an object floats, then watches the reveal.
description: Object above a tank; tap float/sink tile; the object drops and the truth enacts.

title: Melt or Not
subject: science
objective: Orders the states of water by heating and cooling.
description: Ice → water → steam tiles with heat arrows; tap in order both ways.

title: Clock Hour Match
subject: maths
objective: Pairs analogue o'clock faces with the matching digital time.
description: Visible board of clocks and digital tiles; hands differ in length, shape and colour.

title: O'clock or Half Past
subject: maths
objective: Sorts clock faces into o'clock and half-past bins by the minute hand's position.
description: Clock faces stream; bins with a 12-up and a 6-down minute-hand icon; the hour-hand sector shades on error.

title: Quarter Past or To
subject: maths
objective: Reads a quarter-hour clock and chooses between quarter past and quarter to the correct hour.
description: A clock at 3:45; tiles 3:45 / 4:15 / 3:15 as digital; the hour-hand sector and minute ring reveal on error.

title: Five-Minute Ring
subject: maths
objective: Counts the minute hand's position in fives by tapping the ring marks from 12.
description: Tap 5, 10, 15… up to the hand; then tap the time; "big hand on 2 = 2 past" is caught by the count.

title: Calendar Week
subject: maths
objective: Orders the seven days of the week and finds the day after a given one [locale names].
description: Day tiles scattered; tap in order onto a week strip; then "the day after…" prompt.

title: Months Wheel
subject: maths
objective: Orders the twelve months on a year wheel [locale names; hemisphere-neutral seasons].
description: Month tiles; tap in order; wrong order shows neighbours.

title: Measure Judge
subject: maths
topic: unit iteration without gaps or overlaps
objective: Picks the row of cubes that measures an object correctly among rows with gaps, overlaps or a wrong start.
description: Three cube rows under the same pencil; tap the correct one; gaps show as holes and overlaps as stacked cubes on error.

title: Centimetre Reader
subject: maths
objective: Reads the length of an object placed at a non-zero offset on a cm ruler and types it.
description: Object from 2 to 9 cm; keypad; intervals highlight on error; starting-at-1 caught.

title: Heavier or Lighter
subject: maths
topic: comparing mass with a pan balance
objective: Predicts which of two objects is heavier, then sees the balance tip.
description: Two objects; tap the heavier; the scale enacts; bigger ≠ heavier at level 2.

title: Fill the Jug
subject: maths
objective: Fills a jug to a marked line by stepping cupfuls.
description: Step +cup until the line; overfill spills back; tap Check.

title: Length Line-Up
subject: maths
objective: Orders three objects from shortest to longest by tapping them in order.
description: Objects with a common left edge; tap in order; the rail shows length bars.

title: Coin Equivalents
subject: maths
topic: equal values with different coins [locale currency]
objective: Pairs a coin with the group of smaller coins worth the same.
description: Visible board: a 10 coin and 5+5 / 2+2+2+2+2 groups; tap two of equal value; each coin unrolls into unit cubes on error.

title: Enough or Not
subject: maths
topic: comparing a purse total to a price [locale]
objective: Decides whether the coins in a purse are enough to buy a priced item.
description: Purse coins and a price tag; tap enough / not enough; the coins unroll and line up against the price bar.

title: Change Back
subject: maths
objective: Counts on from a price to the amount paid along a money number line.
description: Trace hops from 7 to 10; the hops are the change; wrong hop counts highlight.

title: Pictograph Reader
subject: maths
objective: Reads which row of a pictograph has the most (or fewest) and how many.
description: A pictograph with three rows; tap the row asked; the icons count off on error.

title: Bar Chart Reader
subject: maths
topic: reading a bar chart with gridlines
objective: Reads a value from a bar chart and types it.
description: Chart with integer gridlines; keypad; the bar-top row highlights on error.

title: Compare Two Bars
subject: maths
objective: States how many more one category has than another from a bar chart.
